subject: Revised academic calendar for Semester 8
body:
Dear Students,

The academic calendar for Semester 8 has been revised. Classes will commence on November 9 and the last working day is March 12. Final-year project reviews are scheduled for the second week of December, and each department will circulate its review timetable separately.

All students are requested to download the updated calendar from the college portal and plan their project submissions accordingly.

Regards,
Office of the Registrar
Greenfield Institute of Technology

subject: End Semester Examination Timetable - November 2026
body:
Dear Students,

The End Semester Examinations for all B.Tech programmes will begin on November 24. Hall tickets will be available on the exam portal from November 10. Students must pay the examination fee before November 8 to be eligible for hall ticket download.

Students with attendance below 75% must submit a condonation request to their HOD by November 6.

Controller of Examinations

subject: Revaluation results for Semester 7 published
body: The results of the revaluation applications for the Semester 7 examinations have been published on the exam portal. Students whose marks have changed will receive an updated mark sheet in the department office within 7 working days. No further action is required if you did not apply for revaluation.

subject: Campus Drive: Nimbus Analytics hiring Associate Data Engineers
body:
Dear Final-Year Students,

Nimbus Analytics will conduct an on-campus recruitment drive on November 12 for the 2027 batch. They are hiring Associate Data Engineers (CTC 7 LPA). Eligibility: minimum 7.0 CGPA, no active backlogs, and good knowledge of SQL and Python.

Interested students must register on the placement portal before November 5 and upload an updated resume.

Placement Cell, Greenfield Institute of Technology

subject: Pre-placement talk: Zentra Systems on November 7
body: Zentra Systems will conduct a pre-placement talk in the main auditorium on November 7 at 2:00 PM. The company will present its hiring process for the 2027 batch, followed by an online assessment next week. Attendance is mandatory for all students who have registered for the Zentra drive.

subject: Action needed: update your resume by November 3
body: All students registered for campus placements must upload a verified resume to the placement portal by November 3. Resumes should be a single page in PDF format and include your CGPA, projects and internships. Unverified resumes will not be shared with recruiting companies.

subject: Data Engineer - Bengaluru (0-2 years)
body: A fast-growing analytics startup in Bengaluru is hiring a Data Engineer. Responsibilities: build and maintain ETL pipelines using Python, SQL, Apache Spark and Airflow. Requirements: 0-2 years of experience, strong SQL, and familiarity with cloud data warehouses. Salary: 8-12 LPA. Apply before November 15 using the link below.

subject: Python Developer - Chennai (freshers welcome)
body: BrightPath Software is hiring Python Developers for its Chennai office. You will build REST APIs with FastAPI and Django and work with PostgreSQL. Freshers with strong Python fundamentals are welcome to apply. CTC: 5-6 LPA. Send your resume to the address below before November 20.

subject: Machine Learning Engineer - NLP (open position)
body: Orbitron Labs is looking for a Machine Learning Engineer to work on NLP and large language model applications. You should be comfortable with Python, PyTorch, and deploying ML models to production. 1-3 years of experience preferred. Apply on our careers page by November 18.

subject: Java Backend Developer - Hyderabad
body: Kestrel Fintech has an opening for a Java Backend Developer in Hyderabad. The role involves building Spring Boot microservices for payment processing. Requirements: 2+ years of Java, Spring Boot and Kafka. CTC: 14-18 LPA. Apply by November 16.

subject: Vacancy: Sales Manager - South Region
body: Sunrise Consumer Goods is hiring a Sales Manager for the South Region. You will manage distributors, achieve quarterly sales targets, and lead a team of 8 field executives. Minimum 5 years of FMCG sales experience required. Send your CV by November 14.

subject: Data Engineering Intern - 6 months, stipend Rs. 25,000
body: Nimbus Analytics is offering a 6-month Data Engineering internship starting in January. Interns will work on data pipelines with Python, SQL and Airflow under a senior engineer. Stipend: Rs. 25,000 per month, with a pre-placement offer for top performers. Apply before November 10.

subject: Frontend Developer Intern (React) - apply now
body: PixelCraft Studio is looking for a Frontend Developer Intern to build UI components in React and TypeScript. This is a 3-month remote internship with a stipend of Rs. 12,000 per month. Share your GitHub profile and portfolio before November 13.

subject: AI/ML Research Intern - winter cohort
body: Orbitron Labs invites applications for its AI/ML Research Internship (winter cohort). You will work with researchers on machine learning experiments, including model evaluation and dataset creation. Strong Python and linear algebra skills required. Applications close on November 17.

subject: Interview Invitation: Associate Software Engineer - Round 2
body:
Hi,

Congratulations on clearing the first round! We would like to invite you for the Round 2 technical interview for the Associate Software Engineer role at BrightPath Software. It will be held on November 4 at 11:00 AM on Google Meet. Please keep your resume and ID proof ready and confirm your availability by replying to this email.

Regards,
Sneha Rao

subject: Technical interview scheduled - Data Analyst role
body: Dear candidate, you have been shortlisted for the Data Analyst position at Zentra Systems. Your panel interview is scheduled for November 6 at 3:30 PM. The panel will cover SQL, statistics and a short case study. Kindly confirm your slot at least 24 hours before the interview.

subject: Online assessment link - valid until November 5
body: Hello, as part of the Zentra Systems hiring process, please complete the online assessment using the link below. The test has 3 sections (aptitude, coding and SQL) and takes 90 minutes. The link expires on November 5 at 11:59 PM and can only be attempted once.

subject: Offer of employment - Junior Python Developer
body:
Dear candidate,

We are delighted to offer you the position of Junior Python Developer at Kestrel Fintech with an annual CTC of 6.5 LPA. Your joining date is January 11. Please sign and return the attached offer letter by November 12 to confirm your acceptance.

HR Team, Kestrel Fintech

subject: CodeSprint 2026 - registrations open, Rs. 1,00,000 in prizes
body: CodeSprint 2026, India's largest student coding competition, is open for registrations. The contest will be held online on November 21 and includes algorithmic problems of varying difficulty. Prizes worth Rs. 1,00,000 and internship interviews with sponsors for the top 50 participants. Register before November 18.

subject: HackTheCampus: 24-hour hackathon on Nov 14-15
body: Join HackTheCampus, a 24-hour hackathon for college teams. Dates: November 14-15. Team size: up to 4 members. Themes: AI for healthcare, fintech and sustainability. Free food, mentorship and certificates for all participants. Register your team before November 9.

subject: Reminder: Weekly Contest 142 starts Sunday 8 PM
body: This is a reminder that AlgoArena Weekly Contest 142 starts on Sunday at 8:00 PM IST. The contest has four problems and lasts 90 minutes. Rating changes will be published within 24 hours after the contest ends.

subject: Proposal: strategic partnership for logistics software
body:
Dear Sir/Madam,

I am the Business Development Head at Vertex Logistics. We would like to propose a strategic partnership in which your company supplies inventory software to our 40 warehouses while we provide logistics support to your customers. I have attached a one-page proposal and would welcome a discussion this week. Could you let me know your availability?

Best regards,
Arjun Mehta

subject: Reseller partnership opportunity - 20% margin
body: Hello, GrowthReach is expanding its reseller network across South India. We offer partners a 20% margin on every contract, marketing support, and a dedicated account manager. If you are interested in becoming a reseller, please reply and we will share the partnership agreement and pricing sheet.

subject: Enquiry about bulk order of 500 units
body:
Hello,

I run Iyer Traders in Coimbatore and am interested in purchasing 500 units of your product for the festive season. Could you share your bulk pricing, delivery timeline and payment terms? I need delivery before November 25, so a quick quotation would be appreciated.

Thanks,
Ramesh Iyer

subject: Request for quotation - annual maintenance contract
body: Dear Vendor, Silverline Hospital invites quotations for the annual maintenance contract of our IT infrastructure covering 200 workstations and 6 servers. Please send your quotation and service-level terms by November 9. Shortlisted vendors will be invited for a presentation.

subject: Product demo request for our team
body: Hi, our team at Blue Lotus Interiors is evaluating your software and would like to see a product demo. We are a team of 15 and mainly need customer management features. Could we schedule a 30-minute demo sometime next week?

subject: Invoice #INV-2026-1187 - Rs. 48,500 due November 10
body: Dear customer, please find attached invoice #INV-2026-1187 for Rs. 48,500 for design services delivered in October. The payment is due on November 10. Please pay by bank transfer and share the payment reference so we can confirm receipt.

subject: Payment received for invoice #INV-2026-1143
body: Thank you. We have received your payment of Rs. 21,000 against invoice #INV-2026-1143 on October 29. A receipt is attached for your records. No further action is required.

subject: Meeting invite: Q4 planning sync - Tuesday 3 PM
body: Hi team, I have scheduled the Q4 planning sync for Tuesday at 3:00 PM in Conference Room B (also on Teams). Agenda: roadmap review, resource allocation and client escalations. Please add your updates to the shared document before the meeting and accept the calendar invite.

subject: Reminder: client call with Vertex Logistics tomorrow 10:30 AM
body: This is a reminder that you have a client call with Vertex Logistics tomorrow at 10:30 AM. Dial-in details are in the calendar invite. Please review the proposal notes before the call.

subject: Sprint 14 status: payments module 80% complete
body: Team, here is the Sprint 14 update. The payments module is 80% complete, and API integration testing begins on Wednesday. Two blockers: pending credentials from the bank sandbox and an unresolved bug in refund handling. Please update your tickets by Thursday so we can plan the release.

subject: Reminder: submit timesheets and choose health insurance plan by Friday
body: Dear employees, please submit your timesheets for October by Friday. The annual health insurance enrollment is also open until Friday. Employees who do not choose a plan will be placed in the default plan.

subject: Debit alert: Rs. 4,299 spent on your card ending 4821
body: Dear customer, Rs. 4,299 was spent on your debit card ending 4821 at an online merchant on November 1. If this was not you, please block your card immediately using the mobile app or call our helpline. Never share your OTP or PIN with anyone.

subject: Your credit card statement is ready - due November 12
body: Your credit card statement for October is ready. Total amount due: Rs. 18,430. Minimum amount due: Rs. 920. Please pay by November 12 to avoid late payment charges.

subject: Diwali Mega Sale: up to 70% off, ends tonight
body: Our biggest sale of the year is here! Get up to 70% off on electronics, fashion and home decor. Use code DIWALI10 for an extra 10% off on orders above Rs. 1,999. Free delivery on all orders. Hurry, sale ends tonight at midnight!

subject: Your cart misses you: extra 10% off sneakers
body: You left something in your cart! Complete your purchase in the next 24 hours and get an extra 10% off on sneakers. Use code COMEBACK10 at checkout. Limited stock available.

subject: Data Engineering Weekly #212: lakehouse trends and Airflow 3 tips
body: This week's newsletter covers the rise of lakehouse architectures, practical Apache Spark tuning tips, and what is new in Airflow for building reliable data pipelines. We also feature a case study on migrating ETL jobs from batch to streaming, and a reader survey on Python tooling.

subject: The Startup Digest: funding roundup and founder stories
body: This week in Indian startups: three fintech companies raised Series A rounds, a logistics startup announced its expansion into tier-2 cities, and founders share lessons on pricing and customer acquisition. Read the full stories on our website.

subject: Weekend plans? Family lunch on Sunday
body: Hey! Amma is planning a family lunch this Sunday at home and everyone is coming. Can you make it? Also, don't forget to bring the photos from the Pongal trip. Let me know by Friday so we can plan the food.

subject: Pongal trip photos and travel tickets
body: Hi, I have attached the photos from our last trip and the tickets for the next one in January. Please check the dates and let me know if they work. Take care of your health and eat on time.

subject: Rahul Kumar and 3 others viewed your profile
body: Rahul Kumar and 3 others viewed your profile this week. Upgrade to Premium to see everyone who viewed your profile. You also have 5 new connection suggestions based on your network.

subject: You have 12 new notifications
body: Meera liked your photo. Aditya commented on your story and 10 other people started following you. Open Snapgram to see all your notifications and catch up with your friends.

subject: Library dues notice: return books before November 8
body: Our records show that you have 2 books overdue from the central library. Please return them before November 8 to avoid a fine of Rs. 5 per day. Students with pending dues will not receive their hall tickets for the end semester examinations.

subject: Annual Day volunteers needed - register by November 6
body: The college Annual Day will be celebrated on December 4. The cultural committee is looking for student volunteers for stage management, hospitality and decoration. Interested students can register using the form on the college portal by November 6. Volunteers will receive activity points and certificates.
